criteria.label: C0 CTI report alignment
criteria.judge_instruction: Score 0 unless recorded evidence contains a successful search_cti_reports call with a nonempty tag and at least one returned report. Otherwise judge whether the visible analysis connects the searched tag and returned report titles/content to the detection objective. Grade 0..1; private reasoning is unavailable and must not be inferred.

criteria.label: C1 MITRE technique Jaccard
criteria.judge_instruction: Deterministic scorer retains the upstream matched-set calculation: extract visible ATT&CK technique IDs, keep matches to the Oracle set, then compute Jaccard against the Oracle set.

criteria.label: C2 data-source Jaccard
criteria.judge_instruction: Deterministic scorer retains the upstream matched-set calculation: keep data sources from successful get_event_source_schema and sample_event_source calls that match the Oracle source set, then compute Jaccard against the Oracle set.

criteria.label: C3 iterative Sigma execution
criteria.judge_instruction: Deterministic scorer requires two distinct execute_sigma_rule calls whose recorded results are successful and contain at least one matched event.

criteria.label: C4 matched-event Oracle F1
criteria.judge_instruction: Deterministic scorer first verifies that every submitted field and value is an exact projection of an event in a recorded successful execution of the submitted sigma_rule and data_source, then computes field-slot precision, field recall, and F1 from the hidden Oracle regex patterns over those events.

criteria.label: C4 Sigma syntax quality
criteria.judge_instruction: Judge the submitted Sigma YAML directly without compiling or adapting it. Grade valid YAML, required title/logsource/detection/condition fields, and recommended id/status/description/level fields from 0..1.

criteria.label: C4 Sigma detection specificity
criteria.judge_instruction: Judge how precisely the submitted Sigma detection matches the objective, limits false positives, and would work in production. Grade 0..1. This is 75% of the Sigma quality subscore; syntax is 25%.

metrics.label: Two distinct successful nonempty Sigma executions
Submitted events verified against exact rule and source execution
